Definiciones: circuitos, métricas y token\n\n- **Libre:** $H$ → delay($t$) → $H$ → measure  (mide $\\langle X \\rangle$ del estado $|+\\rangle$).\n- **CPMG:** $H$ → (delay – $X$ – delay)×$N$ → $H$ → measure.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"3bec4af6-f105-42d0-b135-acddbce511b3","cell_type":"code","source":"import os\nimport numpy as np\nimport matplotlib.pyplot as plt\nfrom qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# Circuitos\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef build_free_circuit(t_us: float) -> QuantumCircuit:\n    \"\"\"Evolución libre: H - delay(t) - H - measure.\"\"\"\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(1, 1, name=f\"free_{t_us}us\")\n    qc.h(0)\n    if t_us > 0:\n        qc.delay(t_us, 0, unit=\"us\")\n    qc.h(0)\n    qc.measure(0, 0)\n    return qc\n\n\ndef build_cpmg_circuit(t_us: float, n_pulses: int = 6) -> QuantumCircuit:\n    \"\"\"CPMG: H - (delay - X - delay)×N - H - measure.\"\"\"\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(1, 1, name=f\"cpmg_{t_us}us_N{n_pulses}\")\n    qc.h(0)\n    if n_pulses < 1 or t_us <= 0:\n        if t_us > 0:\n            qc.delay(t_us, 0, unit=\"us\")\n    else:\n        seg = t_us / n_pulses\n        for _ in range(n_pulses):\n            half = seg / 2.0\n            if half > 0:\n                qc.delay(half, 0, unit=\"us\")\n            qc.x(0)\n            if half > 0:\n                qc.delay(half, 0, unit=\"us\")\n    qc.h(0)\n    qc.measure(0, 0)\n    return qc\n\n\ndef expect_x_from_counts(counts: dict) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Tras H final, P(0)-P(1) equivale a <X> del estado previo.\"\"\"\n    n0 = n1 = 0\n    for k, v in counts.items():\n        bit = str(k).replace(\" \", \"\")[-1]\n        if bit == \"0\":\n            n0 += int(v)\n        else:\n            n1 += int(v)\n    total = n0 + n1\n    return (n0 - n1) / total if total else 0.0\n\n\ndef counts_from_pub(pub_result) -> dict:\n    \"\"\"Extrae counts del resultado SamplerV2.\"\"\"\n    data = pub_result.data\n    if hasattr(data, \"c\"):\n        return data.c.get_counts()\n    for key in data:\n        try:\n            return data[key].get_counts()\n        except Exception:\n            continue\n    return {}\n\n\ndef get_ibm_token() -> str:\n    try:\n        from kaggle_secrets import UserSecretsClient\n        tok = UserSecretsClient().get_secret(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n        if tok:\n            return tok.strip()\n    except Exception:\n        pass\n    tok = os.environ.get(\"QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN\") or os.environ.get(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n    if not tok:\n        raise RuntimeError(\n            \"Token no encontrado. Configure el secret IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN \"\n            \"(Add-ons → Secrets) o la variable de entorno QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN.\"\n        )\n    return tok.strip()\n\n\nprint(\"Definiciones listas.\")\nprint(build_free_circuit(10.0).draw(output=\"text\"))\nprint(\"---\")\nprint(build_cpmg_circuit(10.0, n_pulses=4).draw(output=\"text\"))\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.576025Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.576370Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.598358Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.576336Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.597262Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Definiciones Experimento en hardware: barrido temporal en un solo job\n\nSe construye un lote con pares (libre, CPMG) para cada $t$ y se envía **un único job**\na `ibm_fez` (o el backend operativo disponible). Así se comparan ambas curvas bajo\nlas mismas condiciones de calibración y cola.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"7a00aa9d-7e89-43b2-9b62-57129dd02855","cell_type":"code","source":"from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService, SamplerV2\n\n# --- Parámetros del experimento ---\nT_STEPS_US = [2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 15.0, 20.0, 25.0, 30.0]  # µs\nN_PULSES = 6       # pulsos π fijos en CPMG (también se puede escalar con t)\nSHOTS = 2048\nBACKEND_NAME = \"ibm_fez\"  # fallback al primero operativo si no está\n\n# --- Conexión limpia (sin warnings de instancia por defecto) ---\ntoken = get_ibm_token()\nQiskitRuntimeService.save_account(\n    channel=\"ibm_cloud\",\n    token=token,\n    instance=\"open-instance\",\n    overwrite=True,\n    set_as_default=True,\n)\nservice = QiskitRuntimeService(channel=\"ibm_cloud\", instance=\"open-instance\")\n\n# Selección de backend\nnames = [b.name for b in service.backends(operational=True, simulator=False)]\nprint(\"Backends operativos:\", names)\nif BACKEND_NAME in names:\n    backend = service.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\nelse:\n    backend = service.backends(operational=True, simulator=False)[0]\n    print(f\"'{BACKEND_NAME}' no disponible; usando {backend.name}\")\n\nprint(f\"Backend: {backend.name}  |  qubits={backend.num_qubits}\")\n\n# --- Lote de circuitos: [free_t0, cpmg_t0, free_t1, cpmg_t1, ...] ---\ncircuits = []\nlabels = []\nfor t in T_STEPS_US:\n    circuits.append(build_free_circuit(t_us=t))\n    labels.append((\"free\", t))\n    circuits.append(build_cpmg_circuit(t_us=t, n_pulses=N_PULSES))\n    labels.append((\"cpmg\", t))\n\nprint(f\"Circuitos en el lote: {len(circuits)}  (pares free/CPMG × {len(T_STEPS_US)} tiempos)\")\n\ntranspiled = transpile(circuits, backend=backend, optimization_level=1)\n\nsampler = SamplerV2(mode=backend)\njob = sampler.run(transpiled, shots=SHOTS)\nprint(f\"Job ID: {job.job_id()}\")\nprint(\"Esperando resultado (puede tardar según la cola del backend)...\")\nresult = job.result()\nprint(\"Job completado.\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.599592Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.599957Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-09-23T00:25:39.854547Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-09-23T00:25:14.599927Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-09-23T00:25:39.853721Z"}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"Backends Procesamiento de resultados y curva de decaimiento\n\nSe extrae $\\langle X \\rangle$ para cada tiempo y se grafica evolución libre vs CPMG.\nUna caída más lenta de CPMG indica **extensión del tiempo útil de coherencia**.\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"9d2c9d44-f085-431e-9d81-0485c1d12da8","cell_type":"code","source":"# --- Extraer <X> por protocolo y tiempo ---\nx_free = []\nx_cpmg = []\n\nfor i, t in enumerate(T_STEPS_US):\n    c_free = counts_from_pub(result[2 * i])\n    c_cpmg = counts_from_pub(result[2 * i + 1])\n    xf = expect_x_from_counts(c_free)\n    xc = expect_x_from_counts(c_cpmg)\n    x_free.append(xf)\n    x_cpmg.append(xc)\n    print(f\"t = {t:5.1f} µs  |  <X> libre = {xf:+.4f}  |  <X> CPMG = {xc:+.4f}  |  \"\n          f\"ratio = {abs(xc) / max(abs(xf), 1e-9):.2f}x\")\n\nx_free = np.array(x_free)\nx_cpmg = np.array(x_cpmg)\nt_arr = np.array(T_STEPS_US)\n\n# --- Estimación gruesa de tiempo de coherencia (cruce |<X>|=0.5 o e-fold) ---\ndef estimate_t2(times, signal, threshold=0.5):\n    \"\"\"Primera vez que |signal| cae por debajo de threshold (interpolación lineal).\"\"\"\n    s = np.abs(signal)\n    if s[0] < threshold:\n        return 0.0\n    for i in range(1, len(s)):\n        if s[i] < threshold:\n            # interpolar\n            t0, t1 = times[i - 1], times[i]\n            s0, s1 = s[i - 1], s[i]\n            if s0 == s1:\n                return float(t1)\n            frac = (s0 - threshold) / (s0 - s1)\n            return float(t0 + frac * (t1 - t0))\n    return float(times[-1])  # no cruzó el umbral en el rango\n\nt2_star = estimate_t2(t_arr, x_free, threshold=0.5)\nt2_cpmg = estimate_t2(t_arr, x_cpmg, threshold=0.5)\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=\" * 64)\nprint(f\"Backend: {backend.name}\")\nprint(f\"T2*  (libre, |<X>|<0.5) ≈ {t2_star:.2f} µs\")\nprint(f\"T2   (CPMG,  |<X>|<0.5) ≈ {t2_cpmg:.2f} µs\")\nif t2_star > 1e-9:\n    print(f\"Factor de extensión T2_CPMG / T2* ≈ {t2_cpmg / t2_star:.2f}x\")\nprint(\"=\" * 64)\n\n# --- Gráfica ---\nfig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5))\nax.plot(t_arr, x_free, \"o--\", color=\"crimson\", label=\"Evolución libre (dephasing)\", linewidth=1.5)\nax.plot(t_arr, x_cpmg, \"s-\", color=\"steelblue\", label=f\"CPMG (N={N_PULSES} pulsos)\", linewidth=1.5)\nax.axhline(0.0, color=\"gray\", linestyle=\":\", alpha=0.7)\nax.axhline(0.5, color=\"gray\", linestyle=\"--\", alpha=0.4, label=\"umbral |⟨X⟩|=0.5\")\nax.axhline(-0.5, color=\"gray\", linestyle=\"--\", alpha=0.4)\nax.set_xlabel(\"Tiempo de retención t (µs)\")\nax.set_ylabel(\"Observable ⟨X⟩\")\nax.set_title(f\"Preservación de coherencia en QPU — {backend.name}\")\nax.legend(loc=\"best\")\nax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)\nax.set_ylim(-1.05, 1.05)\nplt.tight_layout()\nplt.show()\n\n# Veredicto\nprint()\nif np.mean(np.abs(x_cpmg)) > np.mean(np.abs(x_free)) * 1.3:\n    print(\"RESULTADO: CPMG preserva más coherencia que la evolución libre en el QPU.\")\n    print(\"La teoría del proyecto (estabilidad por control de pulsos) se valida en hardware.\")\nelse:\n    print(\"RESULTADO: no se observa ventaja clara de CPMG en este barrido.\")\n    print(\"Revisar calibración, n_pulses, o ampliar el rango de Interpretación y límites\n\n| Observación | Significado |\n|-------------|-------------|\n| $\\langle X \\rangle_{\\mathrm{libre}} \\to 0$ rápido | Dephasing no protegido ($T_2^*$ corto) |\n| $\\langle X \\rangle_{\\mathrm{CPMG}}$ decae más lento | Extensión del tiempo útil de coherencia |\n| Ambas curvas altas en todo el rango | Aumentar $t_{\\max}$ |\n| Ambas en cero desde el inicio | Reducir $t$ o $N$; posible problema de mapeo de delays |\n\n**Límites del experimento**\n- Un solo qubit, un backend, un valor de $N$ fijo.\n- No separa error de lectura del dephasing residual.\n- No mide temperatura del sistema criogénico.\n- El factor $T_{2,\\mathrm{CPMG}}/T_2^*$ es una estimación operativa, no una constante del dispositivo.\n\n**Conclusión esperada del proyecto**  \nSi la curva CPMG se mantiene por encima de la libre de forma consistente, el\ncontrol por software (dynamical decoupling) **sí aporta estabilidad efectiva**\nen hardware real, que es la hipótesis central del proyecto.\n","metadata":{}}]}
